full_judgment: Mr. Mohammad Gholam Rabbani, J: Leave petitioner Amirul Islam Khan obtained rule in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 1888 of 2001 whereby the High Court Division allowed him to go on anticipatory bail for a period of two weeks from date (27.3.2001) and within the said period the accused was directed to surrender before the concerned court in connection with G.R. Case No. 108 of 2001 and fixing 10.4.2001 for order. Leave petitioner, accordingly, surrendered to the court concerned and his bail bond regarding anticipatory bail for two weeks was accepted. Thereafter as ordered Miscellaneous case came up for order on 29.4.2001 before the High Court Division who by the order dated 29.4.2001 impugned i this leave petition discharged the rule holding the same as infructuous.
